title: GET /menus/v3/metadata answers {restaurantGuid, lastUpdated}, and lastUpdated is the value the full menu document carries

source.note: The Metadata schema has restaurantGuid and lastUpdated, the latter 'The most recent date and time that this menu's data was published. Use this value to determine if you need to refresh your menu data' -- the same definition Restaurant.lastUpdated carries, which is why the second step asserts the captured value against the full document. That equality is inferred from the two identical definitions; no sentence states it. apiMenusV3.html answered 403 to every fetch this session.
